people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.
translations.bsb: Since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there, they prepared their gift for Joseph’s arrival at noon.
translations.kjv: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread
translations.asv: And they made ready the present against Joseph's coming at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
